test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The plan is to __demolish__ the kitchen area and build a new room.
solution:
The correct answer is raze. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word 'demolish' is 'raze'.
 
• demolish: to destroy something, for example a building.(कुछ नष्ट करने के लिए, उदाहरण के लिए एक इमारत)
 
 
• Example:- "the house was **demolished **to make way for the shopping centre"
 
 
 
• Meaning of the given options: Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 3.​
 
 
• **curtail***: *to make **something shorter or smaller**; to reduce(कुछ छोटा या छोटा करना; कम करना)
 
 
• Example:- "civil liberties were further **curtailed**"
 
 
 
• **forge**: to **make an illegal copy** of something(किसी चीज की अवैध प्रति बनाना)
 
 
• Example:- "he **forged **a great suit of black armour"
 
 
 
• ***raze**: **to destroy to the ground***(जमीन पर नष्ट करने के लिए)
 
 
• Example:- "villages were razed to the ground"
 
 
 
• **refurbish**: to clean and decorate a room, building, etc. to make it more beautiful, useful, etc.(किसी कमरे, भवन आदि को साफ करना और सजाना ताकि वह और अधिक सुंदर, उपयोगी आदि बन सके।)
 
 
• Example:- "the premises have been completely **refurbished **in our corporate style"
